changelog.title: The Arctic Barricade
changelog.description: A new frontier has appeared on the horizon. Something stirs beyond the barricade. The seal holds — for now.

changelog.title: CTF Arena
changelog.description: The Arena opens its doors. Enter the first challenge and prove your skills in a fully simulated environment.

changelog.title: Arena Co-Op Mode
changelog.description: Tackle Arena challenges with a partner. Shared sessions, coordinated progress, and team-based scoring.

changelog.title: Dark Arts — New Gate
changelog.description: Another gate opens in the Dark Arts. A new investigation awaits those who have proven themselves worthy.

changelog.title: Decode. Defend. Discover.
changelog.description: A new landing experience welcomes arrivals to Hexworth Prime.

changelog.title: Enhanced Game Mechanics
changelog.description: Visual and gameplay upgrades across all house game libraries.

changelog.title: Content Milestone
changelog.description: The content library crosses a major milestone with expanded coverage across all houses.

changelog.title: Gate Re-entry & Reset
changelog.description: Cleared gates now show completion status with options to revisit or reset progress.
